title: Floor Loading for Returned Deposits — Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service
content:
**Clause.** A Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service with 2 or more returned deposits in the 12 months ending today, a window that takes in every entry dated fewer than 12 whole months before today, adds 30 percent to its replenishment floor, one with a single returned deposit in that window adds 15 percent, and any other service adds nothing for returned deposits. Whole months between two dates are the difference in calendar months between them, less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's.

A returned deposit is a deposit return on the service's ledger: a prefund deposit the employer's bank returned unpaid.

| Deposit returns dated in the window | Loading |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 30 percent |
| exactly 1 | 15 percent |
| none | nothing |

## Window boundary (hypothetical dates, today the 9th of a month)

A deposit return dated the 10th of the same month one year earlier is 11 whole months before today and lies in the window; one dated the 9th of that month is 12 whole months before today and lies outside it.
